programme.title: The Wood Whisperer: David Marks Gallery Tour
programme.desc: In this David Marks Gallery Tour, you’ll see David’s wood boiling apparatus and his art gallery. David recently added an additional two-story building to his property and dedicated it to displaying his various turnings and furniture pieces all for the enjoyment of his students, visitors, and guests. The gallery contains many beautiful pieces by David as well as other amazing woodworkers.

programme.title: The Wood Whisperer: Installing LED Shop Lighting
programme.desc: We're working exclusively with American Green Lights who designed and supplied our lighting solution. The fixtures are PerformaLUX SL Series in both single strip 24 W models and 5-strip 60 W models. These units can save 50-60% compared to traditional fluorescent lights, have a lifetime of 120,000 hours, and feature a CRI of 92-95 (for color accuracy).

programme.title: The Wood Whisperer: I Could Do That Too If I Had Those Tools! - Shop Tours
programme.desc: Community shop tours that will have you drooling.

programme.title: The Wood Whisperer: Platform Bed - The Rails
programme.desc: The rails require tenons and some clever hardware solutions!

programme.title: The Wood Whisperer: MicroJig GRR-Ripper
programme.desc: The GRR-Ripper is an ingenious safety device from the folks at MicroJig. Most power tools can injure you in two primary ways: kickback or blade/bit contact. The GRR-Ripper protects you from both types of injury. It not only allows you to have better control of the workpiece, it also protects your hands should disaster strike.

programme.title: The Wood Whisperer: Sawing off a Box Top
programme.desc: This mini covers the process of sawing off a box top. The idea is that this keepsake box will travel the country to different woodworkers’ shops, and each person will work on one part of the project.
